{{Quote|Most planets have these things called "seasons". Sometimes it's hot, sometimes it's cold, but most of the time, it's downright tolerable.|[[Citizens' Militia|Tatooine Militia]] guard|<ref name="ambient quote">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Outpost Thorazan]]|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
'''Seasons''' were periodic divisions within a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] year. Typically, a year was divided into 4 seasons: [[Winter/Legends|Winter]], [[Spring/Legends|Spring]], [[Summer/Legends|Summer]] and [[Autumn/Legends|Autumn]]. However some planets had other seasons; for instance, the [[Forest/Legends|arboreal]]<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> world of [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] experienced a season called [[Trine]].<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
